name: References settled without a wrong match
purpose: A phrase is tied to the candidate it refers to, and to none when it refers to none of them.
record: Thirty-two invented cases (evaluation/resolve_a_reference/build_cases.py): people named by id, name, first name and email, goals named by title, posts paired with the goal that holds them, and look-alikes that must be abstained on: two unrelated goals sharing words with the request, a first name two people have, a name that is a part of another name, words of two different people. One number: the share settled correctly; beside it, the count of wrong matches.
disadvantages: Invented look-alikes show the failure kinds seen, not the frequency; some correct positives are paraphrases only a model can read, which is why the exact arm scores below 100 percent.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the model-free arms and their rivals were recorded on the same cases] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end through the paid arm and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run resolve_a_reference --impl exact_match; esoi run resolve_a_reference --impl shared_words; esoi run resolve_a_reference --impl model_judged --max-calls 32
